description: This file defines a PHP class 'TestlinkXMLRPCServerTestData' used for generating test data and SQL commands for unit testing the Testlink XML-RPC server. It includes methods for inserting test developer keys and generating test messages, primarily supporting testing activities within the Testlink API project.

classes.name: TestlinkXMLRPCServerTestData
classes.description: A PHP class that provides test data and SQL snippets for unit testing the Testlink XML-RPC server. Contains methods for generating SQL insert statements and messages, but is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that outputs test data messages and developer keys when an instance of the class is created.

methods.name: _getTestDeveloperKeys
methods.description: Private method returning an SQL insert statement for test developer keys, used internally for generating test data.

methods.name: _getNewTCID
methods.description: Private placeholder method intended to generate new test case ID SQL, currently not fully implemented.

methods.name: _getNewTPID
methods.description: Private placeholder method intended to generate new test plan ID, currently not implemented.

methods.name: _getMessage
methods.description: Private method returning an SQL comment string with instructions for inserting test data into the database.
